rows.measured: Absorbs 0.068 +/- 0.0032 per cent of the iron it eats while eating 6.1 mg Fe per day, about 4.2 micrograms absorbed; total body iron 80 +/- 67 mg Fe per kg body weight and an iron turnover half-life of 379 +/- 101 days. Measured by double-isotope labelling in captive bats on their normal all-blood diet.
rows.cite: Morton, D., and J. T. Janning. "Iron balance in the common vampire bat Desmodus rotundus." *Comparative Biochemistry and Physiology. A, Comparative Physiology* 73, no. 3 (1982): 421-5. https://doi.org/10.1016/0300-9629(82)90178-5 PMID 6128125.

rows.measured: Breathing 0 to 10 per cent carbon dioxide, awake and freely moving, ventilation rose only at 10 per cent and metabolic rate did not change at any level. Injected substance P (2 mg/kg) or its long-lived form DiMe-C7 (40 to 400 micrograms/kg) restored a normal response at 2 to 10 per cent carbon dioxide, so the blunting is switched off signalling rather than missing wiring.
rows.cite: Clayson, Maxwell S., Maiah E. M. Devereaux, and Matthew E. Pamenter. "Neurokinin-1 receptor activation is sufficient to restore the hypercapnic ventilatory response in the Substance P-deficient naked mole-rat." *American Journal of Physiology. rows.measured: Broke down more than 90 per cent of the oxalate it ate at every level fed, up to a 3 per cent oxalate diet, with the amount degraded rising in step with the amount eaten. The work is on the animal's gut bacteria, which do the degrading; the woodrat itself has no oxalate enzyme.
rows.cite: Miller, Aaron W., Kelly F. Oakeson, Colin Dale, and M. Denise Dearing. "Effect of Dietary Oxalate on the Gut Microbiota of the Mammalian Herbivore Neotoma albigula." *Applied and Environmental Microbiology* 82, no. 9 (2016): 2669-2675. https://doi.org/10.1128/AEM.00216-16 PMID 26896138.

rows.human: yes; in a randomised trial of 80 calcium-oxalate stone patients, an Oxalobacter formigenes preparation (700 million twice daily) cut the share with hyperoxaluria from 82.5 per cent to 15 per cent at one month. That is the bacterium acting in people, not a purified enzyme on a human target. Jairath, Ankush, et al. "Oxalobacter formigenes: Opening the door to probiotic therapy for the treatment of hyperoxaluria." *Scandinavian Journal of Urology* 49, no. 4 (2015): 334-7. https://doi.org/10.3109/21681805.2014.996251 PMID 25645091.

queries: Show Racer pigeon atherosclerosis resistant White Carneau

rows.measured: Arterial smooth muscle cells from the atherosclerosis-resistant Show Racer breed carry 1.5 to 2.0-fold more syndecan-4 message than cells from the susceptible White Carneau breed, and more syndecan-4 protein at the cell surface, while the susceptible cells proliferate faster and hold less cell-surface heparan sulfate. The two breeds show no consistent difference in plasma cholesterol, so this is tolerance at the artery wall rather than a lower lipid load.
rows.cite: Bortoff, Katherine D., and William D. Wagner. "Reduced syndecan-4 expression in arterial smooth muscle cells with enhanced proliferation." *Experimental and Molecular Pathology* 78, no. 1 (2005): 10-6. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.yexmp.2004.08.010 PMID 15596055.
rows.origins: Once, as a single recessive locus within the species: crossing and backcrossing the two breeds makes susceptibility behave as one autosomal recessive Mendelian trait. This is breed genetics, not a phylogeny of independent origins. Smith, S. C., E. C. Smith, and R. L. Taylor. "Susceptibility to spontaneous atherosclerosis in pigeons: an autosomal recessive trait." *The Journal of Heredity* 92, no. 5 (2001): 439-42. https://doi.org/10.1093/jhered/92.5.439 PMID 11773255.
